$comment: Form & Force brand tokens. The single source for every colour and typeface the brand uses: brand/build.mjs renders from it and site/build.py writes the documentation's CSS custom properties from it. Values were sampled from brand/source/storyboard.png; see brand/guidelines/colour.md.

void.role: The ground of every dark composition. The darkest value; nothing sits below it.

night.role: Surfaces on dark: cards, panels, the documentation page.

dusk.role: Raised surfaces on dark: code blocks, the app-icon tile.

ash.role: The lockup rule and hairlines on dark. Never type.

indigo.role: The first light a fold catches, deep in the shadow.

slate.role: The body of a lit fold.

periwinkle.role: The shoulder of a fold, just before the crest.

lavender.role: The crest: light running along an edge.

glint.role: The specular point where a crest peaks. One per composition, never a fill.

violet.role: Colour carried by light inside a fold. Appears in light, not as a flat fill.

ultramarine.role: The cool end of the chroma, at the foot of a fold.

amethyst.role: The warm end of the chroma, in the violet icon only.

pewter.role: The shadow side of the silver ground.

silver.role: The silver ground of light compositions.

frost.role: The lit side of silver; the silver app-icon tile.

paper.role: Type and the flat mark on dark.

mist.role: Secondary type on dark (7:1 on night).

ink.role: Type and the flat mark on light.

finish.$comment: The mark's two finishes. Gradient stops run along the mark's direction of travel, from the foot of the lower stroke (0) to the tip of the upper stroke (1), across the whole mark, so both strokes share one light.

graphite.use: The mark on light and silver grounds.

theme.$comment: Interface tokens for the documentation. Every text pair meets WCAG 2.2 AA; the ratios are checked by tests/test_brand.py.
